### Fixed
- **`make live-serving-slice` reads the controller's jwks-store in the shape the controller writes it** (giantswarm/agent-platform#515; proof 1 of giantswarm/giantswarm#37639): `tests/verify-serving-slice-live.py` asserted a positive `nkeys` on the `jwks-store-<hash>` entry, a field the store has never had — the entry is `{requestKey, url, fetchedAt, jwks}` as the controller's `jwks` package persists it, `jwks` the fetched JWKS document as a JSON string — so against a healthy controller (gazelle 2026-09-16 23:41Z: `models-jwt` `Accepted=Valid`, two keys for the in-cluster Dex including the token's `kid`) the one live signal #505 introduced failed. The check now parses `jwks` and counts its `keys`, printing their `kid`s (a `401 token uses the unknown key "<kid>"` names the one to compare with), fails naming the URL on an empty set as before, and fails naming the ConfigMap when `jwks` is not a JWKS document; the policy's `Accepted.reason` stays the primary signal. `make verify-serving-slice-store` (`tests/verify-serving-slice-store.py`) holds the reader over `tests/fixtures/jwks-store-configmaps.json`, a copied store in the writer's shape (names and request keys derived as the controller derives them: the issuer with two keys, an issuer with an empty set, a labelled ConfigMap without the entry) with kubectl stubbed — pass, empty set, unknown URL, malformed document; `verify-all` runs it.
